name: PostHog
description: Capture events and run HogQL queries against your PostHog project.

providedTools.description: Run a HogQL query and return the result rows.
Capture an analytics event for a user.

credentialFields.label: Host
credentialFields.help: Your PostHog Cloud region base URL (US: https://us.posthog.com, EU: https://eu.posthog.com).
credentialFields.patternHelp: The region base URL including https://, like https://eu.posthog.com.

credentialFields.label: Project ID
credentialFields.help: Project settings → the numeric project id (used by the query API).

credentialFields.label: Personal API key
credentialFields.help: Account settings → Personal API keys (used as the bearer for queries).

credentialFields.label: Project API key
credentialFields.help: Project settings → Project API key (phc_...), used to capture events.
credentialFields.patternHelp: A project API key starts with phc_. The personal API key is a different one and starts with phx_.
